reason: I won't put a startup without a SOC 2 report in our order path, and this one has no customers and only a planned audit. Nothing in writing from FINRA or the SEC makes me need agent-level pre-trade controls yet, so it's not going into next year's budget.
objection: A proxy that every agent trade has to pass through is now a critical vendor in our order path, and I'd be betting execution and our exam file on an unaudited company with zero references. Even the free design-partner deal costs me engineering time, a public reference and a signed letter of intent naming a price before I know the regulatory picture.
would_change_my_mind: A FINRA or SEC rule or enforcement action that requires agent-level pre-trade controls, with a finished SOC 2 Type II report from them by then.
